target.title: feat: add i18n support for dreaming journal
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The dreaming journal (`DREAMS.md`) has hardcoded English headings (`# Dream Diary`). Users who configure their OpenClaw instance for Chinese/Japanese/Korean etc. get English journal headings regardless of their locale setting. This PR wires a `dreaming.language` config field through the entire output chain so the diary heading adapts to the configured language.

## Changes

### Source (core fix)
- **`src/memory-host-sdk/dreaming.ts`**: Add `language?: string` to return types of `resolveMemory{Light,Rem,Deep}DreamingConfig` and `resolveShortTermPromotionDreamingConfig`; propagate from resolved config.
- **`extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming-narrative.ts`**: Thread `language?: DreamingLanguage` through `appendNarrativeEntry`, `appendFallbackNarrativeEntry`, `generateAndAppendDreamNarrative`, and `startNarrativeRunOrFallback`. Use `getDreamingTranslations(language)` for the DREAMS.md diary heading fallback instead of hardcoded `# Dream Diary`.
- **`extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming-phases.ts`**: Add `language?: string` to `DreamingPhaseStorageConfig`; pass `params.config.language` to all narrative calls in `runLightDreaming` and `runRemDreaming`.
- **`extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming.ts`**: Add `language?: string` to `ShortTermPromotionDreamingConfig`; thread to deep-phase narrative calls.

### Config (unchanged from previous version)
- **`extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming-i18n.ts`**: Translation registry supporting `en`, `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `ja`, `ko` with extensible `registerDreamingTranslations()`.
- **`src/memory-host-sdk/dreaming.ts`**: `language?: string` field in `MemoryDreamingConfig`.

### Removed (per reviewer feedback)
- ~~`scripts/patch-dreaming-i18n.sh`~~: Deleted. The source-level fix eliminates the need for compiled-bundle patching.
- ~~`pr-body.md`~~: Deleted from repo root.

## How to configure

```json
{
  "plugins": {
    "config": {
      "memory-core": {
        "dreaming": {
          "language": "zh-CN"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Supported values: `en` (default), `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `ja`, `ko`. Custom languages can be added via `registerDreamingTranslations()`.

## Evidence

The fix was verified by tracing the full call chain from config resolution through to the DREAMS.md writer:

1. `resolveMemoryDreamingConfig()` reads `dreaming.language` → stored as `resolved.language`
2. `resolveMemory{Light,Rem,Deep}DreamingConfig()` now propagates `language` in their return types
3. `resolveShortTermPromotionDreamingConfig()` propagates `language` to deep-phase config
4. `runLightDreaming()` / `runRemDreaming()` pass `config.language` to narrative functions
5. `generateAndAppendDreamNarrative()` passes `language` to `appendNarrativeEntry()`
6. `appendNarrativeEntry()` calls `getDreamingTranslations(language)` for the diary heading

When `language: "zh-CN"` is configured and the DREAMS.md file doesn't have diary markers, the heading will be `# 梦境日记` instead of `# Dream Diary`.

### Before (English, default)
```markdown
# Dream Diary

<!-- openclaw:dreaming:diary:start -->
...
<!-- openclaw:dreaming:diary:end -->
```

### After (with `language: "zh-CN"`)
```markdown
# 梦境日记

<!-- openclaw:dreaming:diary:start -->
...
<!-- openclaw:dreaming:diary:end -->
```

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101314
